strings.zh: 在这个战斗城堡里{NEWLINE}灵活使用城堡点数,{CLEAR}看看能够撑到什么地步。{CLEAR}城堡点数⋯⋯{SCROLL}也就是ＣＰ会根据你的{NEWLINE}胜利方式和内容发生变化！{SCROLL}推荐用这些ＣＰ{NEWLINE}回复精灵的体力,{SCROLL}或者租借道具来进行战斗。{SCROLL}成功取得７连胜之后{NEWLINE}将获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}另外,如果要临时中断挑战,{SCROLL}必须保存好进度,不然{NEWLINE}就不能从上次的{SCROLL}中断点接着玩了！{NEWLINE}一定要注意这一点！{SCROLL}
strings.en: At the Battle Castle, you may take a{NEWLINE}Single or Double Battle challenge.{SCROLL}Here, you are provided with Castle{NEWLINE}Points (CP) that you must manage.{SCROLL}The CP are used for healing Pokémon,{NEWLINE}renting items or Berries, and so on.{SCROLL}CP are earned by winning matches.{NEWLINE}The amount varies by how you win.{SCROLL}The objective is to keep a winning{NEWLINE}streak alive while managing your CP.{SCROLL}If you manage to win seven matches in{NEWLINE}a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).{SCROLL}If you want to interrupt your{NEWLINE}challenge, please save the game.{SCROLL}If you don’t save, you will be{NEWLINE}disqualified from your challenge.{SCROLL}Please be aware of that!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗城堡！{SCROLL}这儿向您介绍可以和{NEWLINE}朋友一起玩的多人战！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Castle!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Multi Battle{NEWLINE}challenge.{SCROLL}Please be aware that this challenge{NEWLINE}requires two Trainers.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要挑战战斗城堡多人战吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to take the Battle{NEWLINE}Castle Multi Battle challenge? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这儿可以两个人合作{NEWLINE}与训练师进行多人战！{SCROLL}战胜了的话每人都能得到ＣＰ！{SCROLL}ＣＰ不但可以用于自己的精灵{NEWLINE}也可以用于朋友的精灵。{SCROLL}不断征战当成功实现{NEWLINE}７连胜之后,{CLEAR}会获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}另外,在进行多人战的时候{NEWLINE}不能临时中断！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You may team up with a friend for a{NEWLINE}Multi Battle challenge.{SCROLL}Both Trainers are provided with Castle{NEWLINE}Points (CP) that must be managed.{SCROLL}The CP is used for healing Pokémon,{NEWLINE}renting items or Berries, and so on.{SCROLL}Trainers can use their CP on not only{NEWLINE}their own Pokémon, but also their{CLEAR}partner’s.{SCROLL}Both Trainers earn CP by winning{NEWLINE}matches.{SCROLL}The objective is to keep a winning{NEWLINE}streak alive while managing your CP.{SCROLL}If you manage to win seven matches in{NEWLINE}a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).{SCROLL}Please note: a Battle Castle Multi{NEWLINE}Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.{SCROLL}

strings.en: Listen carefully!{SCROLL}If your Pokémon win without taking{NEWLINE}damage, you earn more CP.{CLEAR}The more, the merrier!{CLEAR}Look at me. I don’t have much...

strings.zh: 如果你提升了对手的{NEWLINE}等级并取得胜利,{CLEAR}那你获得的{CLEAR}城堡点数也就是ＣＰ{CLEAR}将会有所增加。{SCROLL}这也就是{NEWLINE}所谓的{CLEAR}风险与机遇并存。
strings.en: Listen!{SCROLL}You can earn more Castle Points or CP{NEWLINE}by facing higher-level opponents.{SCROLL}This is what they call high risk,{NEWLINE}high return!

strings.zh: 在开战之前,{NEWLINE}你别吝啬自己的ＣＰ,{CLEAR}应该在这好好对对手调查一番！{SCROLL}俗话说的好,{SCROLL}不入虎穴{NEWLINE}焉得虎子{NEWLINE}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}呀,貌似不是这么用的！
strings.en: Before every battle, you should check{NEWLINE}the opponent’s lineup.{SCROLL}Don’t be cheap with your CP.{NEWLINE}It’s like that old saying goes about{CLEAR}knowing your enemy.{SCROLL}“Unless you enter the enemy’s lair,{NEWLINE}you cannot take their prize.”{SCROLL}...{CLEAR}That’s not the right old saying!

strings.zh: 刚开始的时候{NEWLINE}只能回复精灵的ＨＰ,{SCROLL}但随着ＣＰ的增加和{NEWLINE}等级的提升,{SCROLL}就算是ＰＰ{NEWLINE}也是可以回复的！
strings.en: At first, you can only use CP for{NEWLINE}restoring HP.{SCROLL}But you can spend CP to rank up.{NEWLINE}Then, you can even restore PP!

strings.zh: 在这座城堡中,{NEWLINE}你要意识到因为一个失败{SCROLL}而让你辛苦积攒的ＣＰ{NEWLINE}付诸东流就和家常便饭一样。
strings.en: If you lose, your entire stock of CP{NEWLINE}is cleaned out to zero!{SCROLL}This is the rule at the Battle Castle.

strings.zh: 我将来的愿望就是{NEWLINE}穿上漂亮的礼服,{CLEAR}住在城堡中！{SCROLL}⋯⋯错了错了！{SCROLL}是和穿着漂亮的礼服的人{NEWLINE}共塌堡中！
strings.en: My dream is to wear a beautiful dress{NEWLINE}and live in a castle!{SCROLL}That’s not what I meant to say...{SCROLL}My dream is to live in a castle with{NEWLINE}someone who wears a beautiful dress!
